claim_definition: Given the exact same script commands and baseline values, the Only-Lang solver evaluates and heals state variables to the exact same values and zero-residual alignment.

test_cases.description: Verifies that solving a baseline balanced budget returns a 0.0 residual exactly every time.
Metamorphic: introduces a sector-0 corruption then verifies the solver still heals to zero residual identically across 5 runs, confirming corruption recovery is also deterministic.
